Name: printer_accuracy_hole_shrink_compensation
Comment: FDM holes always print smaller than modeled due to filament expansion and layer resolution. Add to all hole sketch diameters or apply via Offset Face. Measure a 10 mm test circle: shrink = 10.0 − actual_diameter. Update per machine.

Name: printer_accuracy_outer_dimension_oversize
Comment: FDM outer surfaces print 0.05–0.20 mm larger than modeled due to extrusion pressure. Subtract from shaft and boss ODs for precise fits. Measure a 20 mm calibration cube in X and Y.

Name: printer_accuracy_standard_layer_height
Comment: Default layer height. Base unit for teardrop compensation, bridge sag, and fillet minimums. Update when switching profiles — all derived params follow.

Name: printer_accuracy_first_layer_height
Comment: First layer printed thicker for bed adhesion. Relevant for total Z stack height calculations.

Name: printer_accuracy_extrusion_line_width
Comment: Actual deposited extrusion line width — typically nozzle_dia × 1.10–1.15. All wall thickness and bridge span calcs derive from this. Re-measure after any nozzle change.

Name: printer_accuracy_elephant_foot_compensation
Comment: First-layer squish bulge on outer perimeter — typically 0.10–0.20 mm. Subtract from bottom-surface mating features (flanges, bases) so they sit flush. Dial in with a single-layer calibration square.

Name: printer_accuracy_seam_zseam_protrusion
Comment: Small Z-seam protrusion at layer start. Matters on outer mating surfaces. Either orient seam to a non-mating edge, or add this allowance to surface-critical fits.

Name: printer_accuracy_minimum_infill_bridging_width
Comment: Below this pocket width, infill skips entirely and bridges. Account for this in thin pocket features — infill may not fill them at all.

Name: printer_accuracy_solid_top_layers_for_mating_surface
Comment: Number of solid top layers before a press-fit or heat-set mating surface for best dimensional accuracy. Fewer layers = rougher surface = worse fit.

Name: tolerance_standard_fine_iso2768_f
Comment: ISO 2768 fine class (f) — general linear tolerance ±0.05 mm per side for 3–30 mm features. Requires a well-calibrated machine.
